column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for the solar panel model. Example: Model-102.
TEXT. Manufacturer of the solar panel. NULL means the encoder does not report status or data are missing. Possible values: Canadian Solar, JA Solar, JinkoSolar, Longi, Trina.
TEXT. Type of solar panel technology used. Possible values: Bifacial, HJT, Mono-PERC, Poly-PERC, TOPCon.
REAL. Maximum power output in watts under standard test conditions. Possible values: 450.0, 500.0, 550.0, 600.0, 650.0.
REAL. Percentage efficiency of energy conversion. Example: 20.86.
REAL. Annual power output degradation rate. Example: 0.36.
REAL. Temperature coefficient of power. NULL means the encoder does not report status or data are missing. Example: -0.389.
TEXT. Normal operating temperature range. Example: 45.7.
